messages:
Owen: Quick sync  were swapping CTA microcopy across the launch email to test velocity vs qualification. Need deliverability check, final CTAs, and a ramp plan. Short draft below; please flag by EOD.

Zoe: Love this. What CTAs are we testing? Can we keep subject identical and only change CTA link text + button aria-label? That keeps open rate stable.

Owen: Exactly. Two CTAs: Variant A = "See the numbers" (focus on benchmarks) Variant B = "Start saving tokens" (value-first) Variant C = "Watch the demo" (product-led). Button aria: same text + "open-rsvp" suffix.

Diego: Quick deliverability note: shorter visible text tends to have marginally better mobile CTR. Also avoid repetitive punctuation in anchor text. I'm good with A/B/C.

Priya: Segments: 1) Trials <7d, opens>1 2) Engaged customers (opens>3 last 30d) 3) Lapsed trials (last_login 30-90d). Suggest we only include segments 1+2 for the initial split; 3 gets a tailored followup.

Priya: SQL sample for trial segment:
```
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE trial_start > now()-7
AND email_opens_last_14 > 1
AND unsubscribed = false
AND email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM suppression_marketing)
```

Marta: Ops ask: please freeze the campaign name and utm now. Use utm_campaign=benchmark_microcta&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter. Also share which CTA maps to which RSVP url so we can track utm_content.

Owen: Mapping: A -> /rsvp?utm_content=cta_numbers B -> /rsvp?utm_content=cta_savings C -> /rsvp?utm_content=cta_demo. I'll put them in the sheet.

ops-bot: Campaign preflight: benchmark-microcta-2026 queued. Raw recipients pre-suppression: 11,760. Preview counts per segment pending dedupe. Throttle default: 5k/hr.

Diego: For the split test, recommend traffic allocation: 40% A, 40% B, 20% C on the marketing list. For trials lean 50/30/20 toward demo. That helps qualify intent.

Zoe: What are the success metrics? CTR -> RSVP rate -> demo request. Primary metric = RSVP CTR, secondary = demo conversion within 7 days. Need statistical significance calculator link?

Priya: I'll add RSVP event to the tracking plan and export sample CSV for ops to validate. Also adding a 7d suppression window for recent sends.

ops-bot: Post-suppression preview counts: marketing list = 8,940. Trials = 3,120. Engaged customers = 4,820. Duplicate emails removed: 35. Estimated send waves: three timezone passes. Recommended throttles: 5k/hr first pass, 3k/hr subsequent.

Marta: Suggest we do alarm for bounce rate > 2% during first pass and pause. Also enable domain-level suppression checks.

Owen: Perfect. @Diego can you please run a quick HTML render check on mobile for all three CTAs? @Priya please drop updated SQL + sample to the campaign doc. I'll lock subjects (no A/B) and publish the 3-CTA variants. Final approve = midday tomorrow unless issues. :rocket:
